text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
/*Noise from the surging paddock crowd 
reaches me... Analyzing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
Expectation, doubt, passion... A chorus of 
different voices pours over each and every 
runner.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
To me, it's just meaningless noise that 
doesn't pierce me at all. Today, I'll 
brush off every single voice and etch my 
name into history.
